posts.zh:
dsh-zotero 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。面向 Agent 研究工作流的 Zotero 插件：搜索文献、查看元数据与笔记、提取与问题相关的证据段落、打开原文 PDF、生成引用与参考文献表。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ea199410f5af2c8aac2a.html
posts.en:
dsh-zotero is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Zotero as an evidence store for agents: search your library, inspect metadata and notes, retrieve evidence passages, open source PDFs, and generate citations and bibliographies.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ea199410f5af2c8aac2a.html
